notes.title: Hot Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
Seat Calibration

- Press down the right D-Pad to recenter your position.
- Auto Seat Calibration, Every time you load into your tower, your camera will be automatically calibrated to the seat. 

Join our discussions to request for features and see what's next.

notes.title: Hot Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for all the feedback and here are some fixes we managed to add today.
- Gain supplies in Single Player mode with Bots. You will gain half the supplies compared to online multiplayer.
- Controller Haptic Feedback added.
- Emoticon labels on buttons added.

Our main priority for the next patch is seat calibration to center players. Thanks for playing.
